name: review-check-cache-pr-body
title: Review controller caches sd-check results under an identity that omits the PR body
description: Make a deterministic check whose input is the pull-request body re-runnable after that body changes. The review controller keys its cached sd-check payload on an identity that omits the body, so fixing the body cannot invalidate a stale pack.review-scope failure.
creator: sdelmas
